slides.title: POLARIS
slides.body:
Chief Executive Agent.
Ranks every opportunity, gives each agent one clear focus, and reports to the Founder.

cards.name: ATLAS
cards.text: Scans the US and Latin America for needs people already pay to solve.

cards.name: SIRIUS
cards.text: Finds businesses that need help, from public sources only. Never personal data.

cards.name: VEGA
cards.text: Builds small products that ship within 7 days.

cards.name: ORION
cards.text: Drafts honest outreach. Nothing is sent until the Founder approves.

cards.name: LYRA
cards.text: Content in English and Spanish. Every claim must match the ledger.

cards.name: ALTAIR
cards.text: Onboarding and support, so every customer gets a real first result.

slides.title: NOVA
slides.body:
The trading desk.
Paper trades only, with every trade logged and fees included.
No real money without the Founder and the risk engine.

slides.title:
The Founder
desk
slides.body:
Money moves. Contracts. New accounts. New agents.
No agent ever holds a password or a wallet key.
Every action goes on the ledger.
